detailed_description: The Half Doughnut Chart Generator creates semicircle charts that fit neatly into dashboards, summary cards, and compact presentations. It is useful when you want the familiarity of a doughnut chart but need a lighter layout for progress, split comparisons, or small KPI sections. You can edit segment labels and values, adjust colors and ring thickness, preview the chart on the page, and export the final result as PNG or SVG when it looks right.
usage_steps: Enter the segment labels and values you want to show in the half doughnut chart.
Set the title and adjust the order of slices so the most important comparison is easy to scan.
Choose colors, ring thickness, and legend settings that fit your layout or brand style.
Review the preview to confirm the semicircle chart reads clearly in the space you have.
Export the finished half doughnut chart as PNG or SVG for a dashboard, slide, or report.
usage_examples: Show completed versus remaining work in a compact project status card.
Visualize how a budget is split between a few major categories on a dashboard.
Summarize survey responses in a layout where vertical space is limited.

faqs.question: What is a half doughnut chart?
faqs.answer: A half doughnut chart (or semi-circle doughnut chart) renders a 180-degree arch showing categorical distributions, perfect for compact dashboard gauges and status meters.

faqs.question: Can I adjust the ring thickness and colors?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can customize the inner/outer radius to tune ring thickness, select vibrant color palettes, and toggle legend labels.

faqs.question: Which export formats are available?
faqs.answer: You can export the rendered half doughnut chart directly as a high-resolution PNG image or scalable vector SVG.
